summary: reports to an unrecognized host on a fixed schedule
reason: com.photo.filters.free looked up c2.metrics-collector.xyz every 60 s for the whole monitor window. A fixed schedule to a host that is not a recognized service is how monitoring software reports in. It can also be an ordinary app polling its own server.
remediation: If you do not know what com.photo.filters.free is or why it would report on a schedule, uninstall it. If you do, nothing to do.
label: Review
cardText: Reports to c2.metrics-collector.xyz every 60 seconds, a host nobody recognises.
